RT Mario Nawfal
🚨🇺🇸BREAKING: TRUMP SIGNS ORDER TO BAN TRANSGENDER PROCEDURES FOR MINORS
Trump has signed an executive order banning federal support for transgender medical treatments for children, calling them “chemical and surgical mutilation.”
The order blocks funding for puberty blockers, hormone treatments, and gender-related surgeries for minors.
Trump slammed the practice as “maiming and sterilizing impressionable children” and vowed to end what he called a “dangerous trend.”
The move is expected to trigger legal battles and state-level resistance.
Source: WLBT
